title: Patch: card variants as ladders of levels (art, then animated, then signed), with one picture per variant
thread:
**Issue #3015 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3015: Patch: card variants as ladders of levels (art, then animated, then signed), with one picture per variant
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

## What it does

Asked for on 2026-11-04:

> Currently the cosmetic system is a bit scattered. What we are going to do is create "variations" so for example you might have a sketch variation or alt art variation then there are going to be tiers / levels to the variations, these can add stuff like animations & signature to it. So for example
>
> variant default: default art -> default art with animations
> variant full art: full art -> full art with animations -> full art with animations & signature
> variant sketch: sketch art -> full art sketch -> full art sketch with animation -> full art sketch with animation & signature
>
> NOTES: Signature can only go on a full art card. Every variant should have animations be the next level.
>
> in terms of pulling you should be able to pull stuff out of order and get all previous variants BUT THIS SHOULD BE WAY RARER than just pulling something of the same tier. And of course if you want to buy a card you need all the variants in the cycle.
>
> Go through all cards and make these changes. ALSO MAKE SURE THE ART IS THE SAME WITHIN VARIANTS the difference should be animations & signature and such.

**Blocked by #2942, #2943, #2944 and #3011.** The three open version issues (tracker #2729) add Extended art, Pixel, Comic, Set showcase, Out of frame, Immersive and Prismatic under today's model. This issue converts all of them at once and does not race them for the registry, the painters and the face. #3011 removes the Statistics page's full-art picker, so this issue has one fewer place to carry over.

### Today (SPEC §14.2)

- A card wears one **version**: its normal face, Full art, Alt art, Sketch, Alt full art, and soon the seven above. On it go **augments**: Animated and Signature. Each is its own registry entry (`crates/server/cosmetics.json`, exported as `COSMETIC_OFFERS`), owned, dropped and bought on its own.
- The rulings: R2725000 to R2725004, R2940000 to R2940002, R2949000 and R2949001.
- Signature is worn only beside Full art and Animated, with "a full art and a motion of its own" (R2949000).
- 84 retired full arts count as owning combinations of those entries (R2725002).
- The Full-art cards setting and the 21 full-art cards print full art by default (R2725000, R2655000).
- Foils, finishes and borders layer on everything.

### The model this issue builds

**Variants and levels**

- A **variant** is one picture of a card. Its **levels** are a ladder, each level the one below it plus one more thing.
- **The art is the same within a variant.** Every level of a variant draws exactly the same picture. A level adds presentation on top of it and nothing else:
  - the full-art frame, the same picture across the whole face;
  - animation, the picture's own layers moving (R2715001);
  - a signature.
- This replaces R2949000's Signature look: the signed level is the variant's own full art with its own animation, plus the signature. Nothing is redrawn for it.
- **The owner's three ladders:**

  | Variant | Level 1 | Level 2 | Level 3 | Level 4 |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | Default | the normal face (everyone owns it) | animated | | |
  | Full art | full art | animated | animated and signed | |
  | Sketch | sketch | sketch as a full art | sketch full art, animated | sketch full art, animated and signed |

**The rule every ladder follows**

- First the variant's art levels: its normal-frame form, then its full-art form where it has one.
- Then **animated**, always the next level after the art.
- Then **signed**, only where the level below is a full art. Signature never goes on a level that isn't full art.

**Apply it to every version that exists when this is built.**

- **Alt art.** Alt art, then Alt full art (today's `version-alt-full-art` becomes Alt art's level 2), then animated, then signed.
- **#2942 to #2944's seven versions.** Whether each has a full-art level is a call per version, recorded in a ruling. Extended art and Out of frame already break the frame, and Immersive and Prismatic already move.
- **Legacy cards.** A Training Grounds Legacy card's picture never moves ([R2724000](spec/rulings/R2724000.md)), so its ladders stop before animated. That is the default; the owner may overrule it.

**Every card**

- Each card's offer names the variants it is offered.
- A card offered a variant is offered every level of it, except where the rule above stops a ladder early.
- Every card has at least the Default ladder.
- The offers stay data in the registry, and keep the owner's wish (2026-11-03) that cards differ in their mix of variants.

**Rarity**

- Each level has its own rarity on §14.2's scale (Common to Mythic), rising up the ladder.
- Propose the table and record it in a ruling. For example: the art level at the version's rarity today, each next level a tier up, signed Mythic. No token buys a Mythic (R2728000).

**Layering**

- Foils, finishes and borders stay separate per-card cosmetics and layer on every level (R2720000, R2940002).
- No level uses Radiant's gold, and a Radiant face keeps all its marks under every level (R2725004).

### Owning, pulling and buying

- **No gaps.** Owning a level means owning every level below it in that variant. The server never holds a level without the ones under it.
- **Pulls in order (the normal case).** A duplicate's per-card cosmetic (§14.3) or a cosmetic pack slot (§14.6) rolls its tier as today. What it grants is the **next** unowned level of a variant offered on that card, at that tier.
- **Pulls out of order (far rarer).**
  - A separate, much smaller draw can land a level past the next one. It grants that level **and every level below it** in the variant.
  - Its chance is a named constant in `crates/server/src/config.rs`, for example a skip weight out of `TIER_WEIGHT_TOTAL`, set so that an out-of-order pull is far rarer than an in-order pull of the same tier.
  - A seeded simulation test holds the out-of-order rate to at most a named fraction of the in-order rate.
  - The Purchases page's server-computed odds list it (R1665000).
- **Buying.** A cosmetic token (§14.5) or the Chase Shard (§14.6) buys only the **next** level of a variant: to buy a level, the account must own every level before it. A skip is refused with a 400 and spends nothing.
- **Picks.** A card's pick names one variant and one owned level of it, plus a foil, finish and border as now. The server checks ownership and the offer, and refuses anything else with a 400. The loadout freezes the pick and shows it to the other seat, a watcher and a replay's viewer as it does today (R1834001 to R1834004).

### Moving what exists (nobody loses anything)

- **Ownership.** Each combination an account owns on a card becomes the highest level it covers, with every level below it. Retired full arts map through what R2725002 says each counts as. Examples:
  - Full art + Animated → Full art level 2.
  - Full art + Animated + Signature, or a retired Mythic full art → Full art level 3.
  - Animated on the normal face, or the retired Animated art → Default level 2.
  - Alt full art → Alt art level 2 (and so level 1).
  - Sketch → Sketch level 1.
- **Picks.** Every stored pick keeps drawing what it drew. Where the exact look no longer exists, such as R2949000's Signature look with its own art, rule which level it becomes.
- **The setting.** The Full-art cards setting and the 21 full-art cards keep working. By default the setting shows a full-art card's Full art level 1 when the player has no pick of their own.
- **Old ids.** Old ids still resolve, so frozen loadouts and replays recorded before this still draw.
- **The migration** goes in `crates/server/migrations`, with its SQL tests (`crates/server/tests/sql/`, `tests/db/`) and the store contract tests. A migration that rewrites ownership waits for a person to merge (the bot's merge gate); say so in the pull request.

### Client

- **Collection.** It shows each card's variants as ladders: each level a rung, owned or locked, with the next buyable level marked and the others locked with what they need.
- **The old UI.** Retire the version and augment strip (`apps/web/src/collection/CardCosmeticsView.tsx`, `versions.ts`, `fullArt.ts`'s pick shapes).
- **Faces.** The face reads the variant and level (`CardLook`), and the hand's art-only full-art face (R2723000) still applies at every full-art level.
- **Practice, hotseat and e2e.** These treat every level as owned on the cards it's offered, as today (R1310004).

### Spec

- Rewrite §14.2's versions and augments paragraph and the retired full arts paragraph as **Variants and levels**. Update §14.3, §14.5 and §14.6 for in-order pulls, out-of-order pulls and next-level buying.
- Write rulings in this issue's block, and mark every ruling this changes "amended by". The rulings it changes include R2725000 to R2725004, R2949000, R2949001, R2940000 to R2940002, and those #2942 to #2944 add.
- Put the §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md`.
- It changes how cards look, so add a `--visual` pending fragment.

### Size

This is large: registry, server, migration, drops, tokens, client and spec. The planner may split it into parts, for example:
1. the model, registry and migration;
2. pulls and buying;
3. the Collection and faces.

Each part keeps the game working on its own.

## Acceptance

- **Registry check.**
  - Every variant has ordered levels. A signed level sits only directly above an animated full-art level.
  - Every variant has an animated level after its art levels (Legacy cards excepted).
  - Every card is offered at least Default.
  - The check passes, and `public.cosmetics` is seeded.
- **Same art within a variant.** For every offered (card, variant), every level draws the same picture, by the painter's output or the picture key, base and Radiant. Levels differ only in frame shape, motion layers and signature.
- **Pulls.**
  - An in-order pull grants exactly the next level.
  - An out-of-order pull grants its level and every level below.
  - The seeded simulation shows the out-of-order rate within its named bound of the in-order rate.
  - The odds `GET` lists the out-of-order chance.
- **Buying.** A token or the Chase Shard aimed at a level whose previous level isn't owned is a 400, writes nothing and spends nothing. The next level is a 200.
- **Migration.**
  - A fixture account owning each existing combination, retired full arts included, ends with the levels mapped above, and loses nothing.
  - A fixture of each kind of stored pick draws the same look before and after.
  - The SQL and db suites pass.
- **Picks.** A pick of an unowned or unoffered level is a 400. The loadout freezes a valid pick, and an old loadout or replay still draws.
- **Client.**
  - Collection tests cover the ladders: owned, next-buyable and locked.
  - A component (pixel) spec shows one card's ladders, base and Radiant, with a foil on at least one level.
- **Checks.** `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` passes with a clean `wire/`. The web tests, `typecheck`, `eslint`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh patches check` and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` pass.
```
